Maybe not, but we got in,
so what's done is done.
rows.notes: Male. Answers Luca's c09626 (was it okay to go in there?).

rows.en: Y-You've got a point there...

(I came to the artificial island
with Luca-kun again today.)

Let's skip swimming and go exploring
again today!
Ooh, you're really getting into it!
rows.notes: Female. Reacts to Luca's eager c09622.

rows.en:
The cliffs and all really had
an atmosphere, didn't they?

If you fell from that height,
you'd never survive...

Maybe not, but we got in,
so what's done is done!
Hey, Luca!
He's gone...
rows.notes: x2, both genders; Luca walked off without answering.

rows.en: Guess I'll go after him!

What are you doing loitering outside Nyan-Nyan?
People are gonna think you're some creep!
\p-san!!
Aren't you going into Nyan-Nyan?

Well, which is it?
Make up your mind already...
rows.notes: Male. Luca's answer 'e, ee...' (Y-Yes...) is noncommittal.

rows.en:
Come on, let's go!
Let's get Nanase to hook us up!
rows.notes: Male. saabisu = special treatment/freebies from Nanase.

rows.en: W-Wait, please don't pull me!!
I'm gonna eat a ton!
...I'll go after him!

What are you doing loitering outside Nyan-Nyan?
People are gonna think you're some creep!
Hey, aren't you going into Nyan-Nyan?

Well, which is it?
Make up your mind already...!
Come on, let's go!
I'm gonna eat a ton~!

(School's finally out...
I'm a little peckish, so maybe I'll swing by
Nyan-Nyan.)
Yes, what is it?
Let's go to Nyan-Nyan!
I don't mind, but...
Alright, let's go.

Apparently it's half price today
for groups of two or more.
Then this is our chance.

Then we'll have to eat twice as much
as usual, right?

But then the bill would come out
the same as always...

(School's finally out...
I'm starving, so maybe I'll swing by
Nyan-Nyan?)
Heeey, Luca-kuuun!

Apparently they're doing a half-price
campaign for couples today.
C-C-Couples???
What? Am I not good enough for you?
N-No... I mean... well, yes...
rows.notes: Luca, female scene. He admits she isn't good enough, hence c09666; kept the gag at full strength.

rows.en: How meeeean!!!

(...I wonder if today was
a nice change of pace?)
rows.notes: Female. 'change of pace' as the recurring closing line.

rows.en: (I came to eat with Luca today.)
Nyan-Nyan really is the most relaxing place.
The food's great too.
And the prices are just right!
Yes, let's dig in!
Thanks for the meal.
rows.notes: x8: Luca (frd_luk) and Shirakawa (frd_myk), both genders; as c00480.

rows.en: You really put it away, huh?

Ahaha...
You think so?

You're a bit on the skinny side, Luca,
so you've gotta eat lots and grow big!
(I came to eat with Luca-kun today.)
Nyan-Nyan really is the most relaxing place.

You're a bit on the skinny side, Luca-kun,
so you've gotta eat lots and grow big!
(I came to eat with Luca again today.)
Let's dig in again today!
I haven't eaten a thing since this morning.
You're all fired up, huh!

You stacked up a whole tower
of steamer baskets.
rows.notes: Male. seiro = dim sum steamer baskets.

rows.en: Did I eat a little too much?
I think it's fine once in a while.
Well then, shall we head home for today?
Let's do that.
rows.notes: x42, the player, both genders, many scenes (frd_luk/mcl/myk/pnn/yui, nml_myk, Christmas sub-scenes); generic agreement, as c07518.

You're all fired up!

You stacked up a whole tower

Isn't it fine once in a while?
